# Prior Probability
p_disease = 0.01

# Sensitivity
sensitivity = 0.95

# Specificity
specificity = 0.95

# False Positive Rate
false_positive_rate = 1 - specificity

# Evidence
p_positive = (
    sensitivity * p_disease
    + false_positive_rate * (1 - p_disease)
)

# Posterior Probability
posterior = (
    sensitivity * p_disease
) / p_positive

print(
    f"P(Disease | Positive): {posterior:.4f}"
)

import numpy as np


# Prior Probability
priors = np.array([
    0.7,
    0.3
])

# Likelihood
likelihoods = np.array([
    0.2,
    0.6
])

# Unnormalized Posterior
unnormalized = (
    priors * likelihoods
)

# Evidence
evidence = np.sum(
    unnormalized
)

# Posterior
posteriors = (
    unnormalized / evidence
)

print("Evidence:", evidence)

print("Posterior:", posteriors)
